en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of the Exalted
[30:30] Then set your face for the upright Religion.
en.sarwar: 35. A number of our people has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibrahim al-Hamadani in a marfu‘ manner from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
about the words of Allah, the Most High.
“We shall set up the balance to maintain proper justice on the Day of Judgment. . .” [21:47]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “Balances are the prophets and the executors of their wills.”
